newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU sugar experts fix full molasses tariff.
newsitem.headline: EU sugar experts fix full molasses tariff.

text.p: The European Unions sugar management committee on Wednesday fixed the import duty for cane molasses at the full GATT tariff of 0.41, unchanged from the previous week, an EU official said on Thursday.
The reference price for cane molasses fell slightly to 7.52 ecus per 100 kg compared with 7.58 Ecus last week.
The duty for beet molasses remains fixed at zero based on a reference price of 11.15 Ecus per 100 kg compared with 11.16 Ecus last week.
"The committee fixed the molasses duties and the standing refunds but there were no other matters on the agenda", the official said.
